read_problems: Two tax/carrying-charge scenarios printed (with and without 421-a exemption); used "with 421-a exemption" figures for tax_m and carry_m per convention of using the first column.

cc_m taken as "monthly common charges" column (5); tax_m taken as "monthly" under real estate taxes WITH 421-a exemption column (6); carry_m taken as "monthly" under total projected carrying charges WITH 421-a exemption column (7), consistent with the carry_m = cc_m + tax_m(with) check.
Parking and Retail total rows have no individual unit rows listed (only totals), so no per-unit line was produced for those categories.
